about_the_game:
You can only turn right as you navigate the screen, collecting points and returning them to the goal zone. Avoid obstacles, stay within the borders, and smash power-ups to keep going. Survive as long as possible in this fast-paced, minimalist arcade challenge—the third game in my three-part series.

Press the turn button to rotate 90 degrees to the right. Simple one-button controls make it easy to pick up but hard to master. Play with a gamepad, keyboard, or mouse for seamless input.

  • Easy to learn, hard to master – One-button gameplay with deep challenge

  • Endless score-chasing action – Collect points and return them to the goal zone

  • Unlockable skins – Includes characters from other Adamvision Studios games

  • ‘Close Call’ system – Earn bonus points for near misses

  • Leaderboards & Steam Achievements – Compete for the top score globally

  • Steam Cloud support – Sync progress across devices

  • Steam Trading Cards – Includes profile wallpapers & emoticons

  • Perfect for quick sessions – Great for playing while waiting in queue

  • Simple yet unique sound design – Audio SFX created using my own voice + royalty-free sounds

Righty Tighty XL is a small, replayable arcade score-chaser designed for fast, high-intensity gameplay. As the third game in my minimalist arcade series, it builds upon my original mobile game ‘Righty Tighty’ with refined mechanics and PC-optimized features.

I love crafting simple, polished arcade games and truly value player feedback. If you find a bug, have suggestions, or just want to say hello, reach out via Discord or my website.

Thanks for playing!
Adam Nickerson - Adamvision Studios
